headline: Library Extends Weeknight Hours
text:
Library Extends Weeknight Hours

Residents packed the meeting room, many carrying signs and asking for more detail about how the money would be spent. For now, the practical effect is modest: a handful of new signs, a revised schedule and a promise to revisit the issue in the fall. Construction crews closed two lanes of the bridge for most of the afternoon, causing delays across the city. Officials said the plan would take effect next spring, though several members warned that the timeline could slip again. Work is expected to begin along the waterfront corridor before the end of the year, weather permitting. The library will extend its hours on weeknights beginning next month, funded by a private grant. The city council approved a new budget on Tuesday, setting aside funds for transit, parks and a long-delayed repair program. Analysts described the decision as a compromise that leaves almost everyone partly satisfied and partly frustrated.
